raw_text: Nepal-China trans-Himalayan railway deal signed. Kerung to Kathmandu, $3.5B Chinese financing. This is a game changer for South Asian geopolitics. India will be deeply uncomfortable with Chinese-built rail infrastructure reaching so close to the open India-Nepal border. Dual-use implications are obvious despite the civilian framing.
